args.sql:
WITH station_data AS (
    SELECT 
        o.observstation as station_name,
        ROUND(CAST(o.atmostransparency * (1 - o.humidityrate/100.0) * (1 - 0.02 * o.windspeedms) AS numeric), 4) as aoi,
        o.lunarstage,
        o.lunardistdeg,
        o.solarstatus
    FROM signals s 
    JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry 
    JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
),
oow_check AS (
    SELECT *,
        CASE WHEN aoi > 0.85 
            AND lunarstage IN ('New', 'First Quarter')
            AND lunardistdeg > 45
            AND solarstatus IN ('Low', 'Moderate')
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END as meets_oow
    FROM station_data
)
SELECT 
    meets_oow,
    COUNT(*) as station_count,
    ROUND(CAST(AVG(aoi) AS numeric), 4) as avg_aoi,
    json_agg(
        json_build_object(
            'station_name', station_name,
            'aoi_value', aoi,
            'lunar_factors', json_build_object('lunar_stage', lunarstage, 'lunar_distance', lunardistdeg),
            'solar_condition', solarstatus
        )
    ) as environmental_factors
FROM oow_check
GROUP BY meets_oow;

        o.observstation as station_name,
        ROUND(CAST(o.atmostransparency * (1 - o.humidityrate/100.0) * (1 - 0.02 * o.windspeedms) AS numeric), 4) as aoi,
        o.lunarstage,
        o.lunardistdeg,
        o.solarstatus
    FROM observatories o
),
oow_check AS (
    SELECT *,
        CASE WHEN aoi > 0.85 
            AND lunarstage IN ('New', 'First Quarter')
            AND lunardistdeg > 45
            AND solarstatus IN ('Low', 'Moderate')
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END as meets_oow
    FROM station_data
)
SELECT 
    meets_oow,
    COUNT(*) as station_count,
    ROUND(CAST(AVG(aoi) AS numeric), 4) as avg_aoi,
    json_agg(
        json_build_object(
            'station_name', TRIM(station_name),
            'aoi_value', aoi,
            'lunar_factors', json_build_object('lunar_stage', lunarstage, 'lunar_distance', lunardistdeg),
            'solar_condition', solarstatus
        )
    ) as environmental_factors
FROM oow_check
GROUP BY meets_oow;
